title: Leadership and Role Models
text: Learn how role models and leadership skills can shape your career and help you grow.
cdi_links: 4.C.05 Being able to discuss role models and reflect on leadership

title: Introduction
bullets: Role models inspire and influence career choices and personal growth
Leadership is about guiding, supporting, and motivating others, not just holding a title
This lesson explores how role models affect our development and how to practise leadership
You will reflect on your own leadership and consider ways to grow these skills

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can explain what leadership skills are
I can describe how role models influence careers
I can reflect on my own leadership skills and goals
I can identify at least one way to develop leadership in my life

title: Key Words
bullets: Leadership Skills – Abilities that help someone guide, support, and motivate others
Career Influence – How someone or something shapes your career choices
Reflection – Thinking deeply about your experiences and what they mean
Professional Growth – Developing skills and qualities that help you succeed in your career

title: Starter Activity
bullets: Think of someone at school or in your community who helps or inspires others
What do you like about how they act?
Have you ever had a teacher, coach, or family member show leadership? How did it help you?
Can you think of a skill or quality you admire in someone you know?

title: Leadership and Role Models in Action
bullets: Leadership involves helping others reach a goal, showing responsibility, solving problems, and motivating a team
Role models influence career choices, help develop skills and confidence, and demonstrate qualities you may want to practise
Look for role models who inspire you by how they treat others or how they work
Practise leadership skills through school projects, work experience, volunteering, or helping peers

title: Activity – Reflecting on Leadership and Role Models
text: Identify a role model who inspires you or shows leadership.

title: Leadership Skills
sentence: Leadership skills include ______, responsibility, problem-solving, and motivating others.

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Role models and leadership skills shape your career development and personal growth
Practising leadership and learning from others helps you build confidence, responsibility, and professional skills
